svg.title: Astronomer — Non-binary person
svg.desc: A fictional non-binary person working as astronomer, wearing a plain work shirt. Visible work cue: A long inclined optical telescope has a small eyepiece and three distinct tripod legs. The person is on the left, with the work cue on the right. Appearance: a shaved head, a rounded face.
